statements.impact_statement: Codex rechecked the pinned Trivy 0.76.1 execution paths and current advisory on 2026-11-16. Code Polishy enables version, anonymous OCI database download through go-containerregistry/net/http, and offline archive scans. Inputs cannot configure SPIFFE/xDS credentials or Sigstore OIDC; image-configuration JWT analysis uses a separate JWK implementation. No enabled input reaches go-jose RSA private-key validation. Reassess by 2026-12-07 UTC and whenever the image, execution contract, inputs or advisory changes.

Codex rechecked GO-2026-6860 on 2026-11-16 against the unchanged image and November 8 binary evidence for both pinned Linux amd64 and arm64 executables. Validated Go runtime function-name tables, including inlined functions, contain html.init and charset routines but none of the affected HTML Parse entry points or parser methods. The vulnerable text-node coalescing code is absent from both binaries; x/net v0.60.0 remains present. Exact platform and executable digests, positive controls and reproducible inspection are in the immutable evidence. Reassess by 2026-12-07 UTC and on image, build, execution-contract or advisory changes.

Codex reviewed GO-2026-6859 on 2026-11-20. The race requires an HTTP/1 server response writer and concurrent body-limit handling. Enabled version, registry-client database download and standalone archive scans create no HTTP server or handler. Inputs cannot enable server mode. Reassess by 2026-12-07 or on image, contract, input or advisory changes.

Codex reviewed GHSA-vwhp-8p66-mq4f on 2026-11-20. Archive readers and OCI database download use go-containerregistry, not containerd transfer or SetChildrenMappedLabels. Inputs cannot enable a containerd service or content-store labeling. This excludes the separate host daemon. Reassess by 2026-12-07 or on image, contract, input or advisory changes.

evidence: Execution-path and binary evidence: https://github.com/riteofstring/code-polishy/blob/bacaf2e32e02dacc972dac9a70f52b53bb744b3c/docs/design/trivy-scanner-assessments.md . All statements bind this image and code-polishy-trivy/v1.
